summary: Frontend regression after 6 client changes on Galista Café site. Tested on mobile 375px and desktop 1440px: (1) BUG mobile language switcher - FIXED/VERIFIED: FR/DE/EN all visible in top nav bar at x=122/157/194 y=19, no need to open burger, no horizontal overflow (scrollW=375=clientW). (2) Hero epure - VERIFIED: hero-static has 1 img (ornament only) and 0 buttons; no 'Voir la carte', no 'Itinéraire', no 'Appeler' text in hero. Title 'La pause istanbulienne.' + subtitle + badge 'Ouvert · jusqu'à 17:00' visible. Overlay is clearer - interior photo (turquoise arches, Galista neon, pastry display) clearly visible with cream text still readable. (3) Carte section - VERIFIED: no 'La carte complète.' title, kicker 'LA CARTE' present on top. (4) Buttons preserved elsewhere - VERIFIED: nav-find-btn 'Nous trouver' visible desktop, mobile-action-bar visible on mobile with Appeler+Itinéraire, infos section contains Appeler+Maps buttons. (5) i18n - VERIFIED: EN switch from mobile redirects to /en with 'A coffee break, the Istanbul way.', DE shows 'Eine Auszeit wie in Istanbul.', no raw keys ('carte.title', 'hero.cta_menu') leaking. FR switch back works. (6) Regressions - no horizontal overflow desktop 1440 (scrollW=1440). Only 1 console error (resource 404 - likely preexisting Instagram/Apple-touch-icon). All 6 requested changes work as expected.
